svg.title: Cosine similarity equals the vector dot product divided by the product of vector norms. The program prints this text-similarity value as a percentage, not a hiring probability.
svg.desc: Cosine similarity equals the vector dot product divided by the product of vector norms. The program prints this text-similarity value as a percentage, not a hiring probability. Conceptual document/vector artwork, not an actual resume, a measured match score or a hiring prediction.
